title: Your team’s Christmas: an exclusive 20% off food
preheader: An email-only offer for local businesses. Book before 31 October 2026 to save on food.

data.heading: A Christmas thank-you for our local businesses
body: Following our August email, we wanted to give our local business neighbours an extra reason to get Christmas in the diary: an exclusive email offer of 20% off food.

We’re booking up fast for the festive season, and we want to prioritise local businesses wherever possible. Whether it’s a small team dinner or a larger company celebration, let us know how we can help.

Book before 31 October 2026 to receive 20% off food only. This email-only deal is exclusively for local businesses; drinks and other charges are excluded. Mention this email when you enquire so we can include the offer in your quote.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner at The Anchor: roast beef, a Yorkshire pudding, pigs in blankets, stuffing, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts

data.heading: A team dinner or the whole company
body: Christmas dining runs from 10 November to 20 December. Dinner bookings start at four guests, and festive buffets are available for groups of 30 or more.
For Christmas dinner, a £10 deposit per person is taken at booking and deducted from your bill. Tell us your plans and we’ll confirm availability and the next steps.

data.body: Tell us your preferred date, rough numbers and what you have in mind. Mention this email so we can include the food offer in your quote.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, because you said we could get in touch, or because you are just down the road and we thought this would be useful. It may have been a while ago now, and it is good to still be in touch.
